requestError: The request could not be completed.
unchanged: Display transformations do not change the source data.
overlayBlocked: Sources with missing or conflicting CRS cannot overlay other layers. Open separately to inspect native coordinates.
nativeLimit: Source CRS is missing or conflicting. Geographic placement is not inferred and area analysis is disabled.
subset: The map and attribute table are display previews. Rasters are drawn from nearest-neighbour sample tiles, not full-data analysis.
pixelHint: Click the map to read the pixel value at that location from the source file.
outsidePixel: The clicked location is outside the raster.
areaHint: Area never uses the viewport or display CRS. Choose a CRS suitable for area analysis for the projected method. EPSG:3857 is not used.
totalArea: Total area: {area} m² · full-layer features: {count} · empty geometries: {empty}
fullLayer: Scope: full layer · method: {method} · area CRS: {crs}
figureNotice: The PNG contains only currently rendered data. Use the area table for full-layer analysis.
invalidManifest: Could not read map artifact layers.
addTiff: This TIFF has no georeference. Open separately in the imaging viewer.
displayFallback: Artifact display settings are transformed to this map's common display CRS. Source CRS is preserved.
mapError: Could not render the map. Check the data format and extent.
areaError: Could not retrieve the full-layer area table.
rangeLow: {value} or less (2nd percentile of an overview sample)
rangeHigh: {value} or more (98th percentile of an overview sample)
vectorFull: All features of the layer are read once and drawn; panning and zooming send no new requests.
vectorViewport: The layer has many features or vertices, so up to 500 features in the current view are read and drawn.
